caption:
42 state AGs move to stop Character.AI from selling user chats

A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling user data during its Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. In nearly identical press releases, the AGs accuse the company of planning to auction off the private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts.

Reported by The Verge; Engadget; TechCrunch.
